helpFaq.title: Help and FAQ
helpFaq.q1: How do I cancel a booking?
helpFaq.a1: Open the booking from your Activity tab and tap Cancel. You don't need a reason, but please cancel as early as you can so the store can free up the slot.
helpFaq.a2: There's no direct reschedule yet — cancel the existing booking from Activity, then book the new time you want.
helpFaq.a3: Slotify doesn't take payment in the app. You pay the store directly when you arrive for your booking.
helpFaq.a4: Since payment happens at the store rather than in the app, cancelling a booking here doesn't involve a charge or a refund.
helpFaq.q5: Can I change my phone number?
helpFaq.a5: Yes, from You > Edit profile. Changes to your phone number are saved immediately without a verification step, so make sure you type it correctly.
